# Fiction & Fact Library

> Free reading and English tools for students in grades 2–8 (ages about 7–14) and their teachers: four interactive tools, each with a short lesson, a printable one-page worksheet and a teacher answer key. Everything runs in the browser with no sign-up and no ads. The site also has Listen, a player for free public-domain audiobooks read by LibriVox volunteers. From the makers of Interactive Periodic Table.

## Tools

- [Reading Tools: Free Interactive Practice for Grades 2–8](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/): Free interactive reading tools for grades 2–8, each with a printable worksheet and a teacher answer key. They run in the browser with no sign-up or ads.
- [Cause and Effect Game: Free Practice for Grades 2–8](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/cause-and-effect/): Free cause and effect game for grades 2–8: tap the cause or the effect, spot signal words, match pairs and follow a chain of events. With examples.
- [Context Clues Game: Free Practice for Grades 2–8](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/context-clues/): Free context clues game for grades 2–8: work out what a word means from definition, synonym, antonym, example and inference clues. With examples.
- [Fact or Opinion Game: Free Practice for Grades 2–8](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/fact-or-opinion/): Free fact or opinion game for grades 2–8: sort statements, learn the clue words and find the opinion inside a sentence. With fact vs opinion examples.
- [Reading Level Checker: Free Readability & Grade Level Tool](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/reading-level/): Free reading level checker: paste any text to see its grade level, age range, Flesch Reading Ease and Flesch–Kincaid score. Nothing you type is saved.

## Classroom

- [For Teachers: Free Reading Worksheets & Answer Keys](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/teachers/): Free reading tools for grades 2–8 with printable one-page worksheets, teacher answer keys and short lesson plans. No logins, no ads, Chromebook-ready.
- [Cause and Effect Worksheet: Free Printable, Grades 3–6](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/cause-and-effect/activity/): Free printable cause and effect worksheet for grades 3–6: mark the cause and effect in eight sentences, match five pairs and draw a chain. With answer key.
- [Context Clues Worksheet: Free Printable, Grades 3–6](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/context-clues/activity/): Free printable context clues worksheet for grades 3–6: find the clue in eight sentences, write each meaning and name the type of clue. With answer key.
- [Fact or Opinion Worksheet: Free Printable, Grades 3–6](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/fact-or-opinion/activity/): Free printable fact or opinion worksheet for grades 3–6: sort ten statements, find the opinion inside four sentences and write your own. With answer key.
- [Reading Level Worksheet: Rewrite for a Younger Reader](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/reading-level/activity/): Free printable reading level worksheet for grades 4–8: students check a passage, record the numbers, rewrite it for a younger reader and check it again.

## Listen

- [Listen: Free Classic Audiobooks Read Aloud Online](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/listen/): Listen to free public-domain audiobooks online: classic stories, poems and non-fiction read aloud by LibriVox volunteers. No sign-up, nothing to install.

- [About Fiction & Fact Library](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/about/): Fiction & Fact Library makes free reading tools for students in grades 2–8 and their teachers, with no sign-up and no ads. Here is who makes it and how.
- [Privacy Policy](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/privacy/): How Fiction & Fact Library handles your data: no accounts, no ads, no personal details, anonymous statistics, and what stays in your browser.
